display.purpose: Owner's name on home only, ink fit edge to edge: font-size 100cqw / --fit (6.764 one line; 4.007 two lines at container <= 520px, line-height 0.92), margin-left -0.03125em.

headline.purpose: Index page names; case-study, article, Contact, More and 404 heads use sibling clamps in Anton.

label.purpose: Base text of the site: nav, filters, columns, numbers, dates, link labels, contact values. Caps at 0.04em where uppercase. Tabular numbers.

body.purpose: Long-form prose at a 68ch measure. Roboto appears only for reading text.

summary.purpose: One line under each ledger title, 60ch.

shadows.name: chart-dot-ring
shadows.purpose: Blue ring around 10px chart dots so they read where lines cross. Not elevation; the system is flat.

motion.name: wipe
motion.purpose: The only interaction motion: white bar scaleX from the right and the blue label copy's clip-path, same duration and easing. Inline prose links animate a registered --p percentage on the same value. Removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Wipe Link
components.description: Every link and button. Label drawn twice; the blue copy is clipped in step with the white bar sweeping in from the right.
components.html: PROJECTSPROJECTS
components.css: .ds-wipe { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: inline-flex; color: var(--paper, #fff); background: var(--ink, #061ecf); text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Roboto Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; outline: none; } .ds-wipe::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 0; background: var(--paper, #fff); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: right; transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-lbl { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5em; padding: 0.25em 0.5em; } .ds-ink { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 2; color: var(--ink, #061ecf); pointer-events: none; clip-path: inset(0 0 0 100%); transition: clip-path 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-wipe:is(:hover, :focus-visible, :active)::before { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-wipe:is(:hover, :focus-visible, :active) > .ds-ink { clip-path: inset(0); }

components.name: Held Wipe (selected)
components.description: Current page, pressed filter, current section: the wipe stays drawn.
components.css: .ds-held { display: inline-flex; gap: 0.5em; padding: 0.25em 0.5em; border: 0; background: var(--paper, #fff); color: var(--ink, #061ecf); font-family: 'Roboto Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; cursor: pointer; } .ds-held:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--paper, #fff); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Brand left, four caps mono wipe links right; current section held.
components.html: MYKY.CCPROJECTSWRITINGABOUTCONTACT
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 24px; padding: 20px 24px; background: var(--ink, #061ecf); font-family: 'Roboto Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-nav span { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-nav-a { color: var(--paper, #fff); text-decoration: none; padding: 0.25em 0.5em; background: linear-gradient(var(--paper, #fff), var(--paper, #fff)) right / 0% 100% no-repeat; transition: background-size 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), color 0s 0.1s; } .ds-nav-a:hover, .ds-nav-a:focus-visible, .ds-on { background-size: 100% 100%; color: var(--ink, #061ecf); outline: none; }

components.name: Ledger Row
components.description: One numbered entry: mono number, year, kind; Anton title and Roboto summary on --lead; mono action. 2px white rule below.
components.html: 062026RESEARCHHOW A RESEARCH PIECE IS PUT TOGETHERA sample piece that shows every part a research article can use.READ →
components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 3rem 4.25rem 7.5rem minmax(0, 1fr) auto; column-gap: 20px; align-items: baseline; padding: 18px 10px; color: var(--paper, #fff); background: var(--ink, #061ecf) linear-gradient(var(--paper, #fff), var(--paper, #fff)) right / 0% 100% no-repeat; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--paper, #fff); text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Roboto Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; transition: background-size 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-t { font-family: Anton, Impact, sans-serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 2.5rem; line-height: 0.95; letter-spacing: 0; display: grid; gap: 6px; } .ds-t small { font-family: Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.45; text-transform: none; } .ds-row:hover, .ds-row:focus-visible { background-size: 100% 100%; color: var(--ink, #061ecf); outline: none; }

components.name: Contact Row
components.description: Icon (stroke 2) and caps service, value on --lead, up-right arrow; ruled top and bottom.
components.css: .ds-contact { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 14rem minmax(0, 1fr) auto; column-gap: 20px; align-items: center; padding: 0.7em 10px; font-size: 1.5rem; color: var(--paper, #fff); background: var(--ink, #061ecf) linear-gradient(var(--paper, #fff), var(--paper, #fff)) right / 0% 100% no-repeat; border-top: 2px solid var(--paper, #fff); border-bottom: 2px solid var(--paper, #fff); text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Roboto Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 700; transition: background-size 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-contact > span:first-child { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-contact:hover, .ds-contact:focus-visible { background-size: 100% 100%; color: var(--ink, #061ecf); outline: none; }

components.css: .ds-facts { margin: 0; background: var(--ink, #061ecf); color: var(--paper, #fff); border-top: 2px solid var(--paper, #fff); font-family: 'Roboto Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 700; } .ds-facts > div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 15rem minmax(0, 1fr); column-gap: 20px; align-items: baseline; padding: 14px 0; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--paper, #fff); } .ds-facts dt { letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-facts dd { margin: 0; } .ds-say { font-family: Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 1.375rem; line-height: 1.4; max-width: 48ch; }

components.name: Inline Prose Link
components.description: The wipe drawn with background layers so it survives line breaks: --p sizes the bar and the blue text fill from the right; 2px underline at rest.
components.html: MDX is Markdown that can hold components like charts and still reads as plain text.
components.css: @property --p { syntax: '<percentage>'; inherits: false; initial-value: 0%; } .ds-prose { background: var(--ink, #061ecf); color: var(--paper, #fff); font-family: Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1.6; padding: 16px; max-width: 40ch; } .ds-plink { --p: 0%; color: var(--paper, #fff); text-decoration: none; background: linear-gradient(var(--ink, #061ecf), var(--ink, #061ecf)) right / var(--p) 100% no-repeat, linear-gradient(var(--paper, #fff), var(--paper, #fff)), linear-gradient(var(--paper, #fff), var(--paper, #fff)) right / var(--p) 100% no-repeat, linear-gradient(var(--paper, #fff), var(--paper, #fff)) left bottom / 100% 2px no-repeat; -webkit-background-clip: text, text, border-box, border-box; background-clip: text, text, border-box, border-box; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; -webkit-box-decoration-break: clone; box-decoration-break: clone; transition: --p 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-plink:is(:hover, :focus-visible, :active) { --p: 100%; outline: none; }

components.name: Chart Bars
components.description: Square-ended white bars with the value at the tip; series in line charts differ by line style (solid, dashed 8 6, dotted 0.5 6), never color.
components.css: .ds-chart { background: var(--ink, #061ecf); color: var(--paper, #fff); font-family: 'Roboto Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 16px; margin: 0; } .ds-chart figcaption { letter-spacing: 0.04em; padding-bottom: 10px; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--paper, #fff); margin-bottom: 14px; } .ds-bar { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 6rem auto 1fr; align-items: center; column-gap: 10px; min-height: 28px; } .ds-bar i { display: block; height: 20px; width: calc(var(--f) * 18rem); background: var(--paper, #fff); } .ds-bar b { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
The site is a record, not a showcase. One saturated blue field carries white ink and nothing else; the owner's name is set as wide as the column allows, and under it everything made and written runs as one numbered list, newest first, ruled off in 2px white lines. Hierarchy comes from scale and typeface, never from color, boxes, or depth.

Three typefaces split the work cleanly. Anton, uppercase, speaks: the name, page names, entry titles, section heads. Roboto Mono Bold measures: numbers, dates, columns, filters, navigation, every link label. Roboto reads: it appears only where someone settles in for long text (summaries, case-study answers, article prose). Interaction is one motion, the wipe, and a held wipe is the only "selected" state on the site.

Density is calm and dry. Empty space is part of the design and is not filled to balance a page. Pages are long, single-column records whose columns line up on one shared edge, `--lead`, from the ledger down through the contact rows.
keyCharacteristics: Two colors only: blue field, white ink. Translucent white exists only for recessive chart lines.
Anton for what is named, Roboto Mono 700 for what is counted or clicked, Roboto for what is read.
2px white rules between rows; no cards, panels, or outlined boxes.
One motion, the wipe, for hover, focus, press, and every selected state.
One vertical edge (`--lead`) shared by ledger titles, contact values, fact values, and prose.
Square everything: no radii on surfaces.

rules.name: The Two Inks Rule
rules.body: Blue and white are the whole palette. White on blue is the default; blue on white appears only where a white fill is the subject (wipe, code, readout). No third color, no gradient, no tinted text.

rules.name: The No-Fade Text Rule
rules.body: Text is full white. Faint white is a line weight for charts, not a text tone; secondary information is made smaller or moved to mono, not dimmed. Disabled controls (opacity 0.45) are the one exception.

rules.name: The Three Jobs Rule
rules.body: Anton names, mono counts and links, Roboto reads. Roboto never labels or links outside running text; mono never carries paragraphs.

rules.name: The Full-Width Name Rule
rules.body: The name is sized from its container, not a breakpoint, and its ink, not its em box, meets both column edges.

rules.name: The One Edge Rule
rules.body: Everything that is a "value" starts on `--lead`: ledger titles and summaries, contact values (label column `--lead − --col-gap`), case-study and About fact values, case-study prose (margin-left `--lead` from 760px), About prose, and article prose (a two-column grid whose first column holds the sticky contents list). One edge runs down every page.

rules.name: The Flat Field Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats above the blue. If an element needs emphasis, invert it or make it larger.

rules.name: The Rules Not Boxes Rule
rules.body: Content is never enclosed in a bordered or filled card. The one frame on the site is the 2px rule around a case-study cover screenshot, because a picture of a blue page on a blue page would otherwise read as part of this one.

dos: Do route every link and button through the wipe, and express every selected state as a held wipe.
Do start every value column and every block of prose on `--lead`.
Do separate rows with 2px white rules (`--rule`) and close lists top and bottom.
Do set names and titles in uppercase Anton, data and links in Roboto Mono 700 with tabular numbers, and long reading text in Roboto.
Do size the name from its container with a measured `--fit` and the -0.03125em bearing pull-back.
Do distinguish chart series by line style and give every chart a data table.
Do use 1.5 stroke for small icons and 2 for the big contact icons.
donts: Don't add a color, tint, gradient, glow, blur, or shadow; the palette is blue and white.
Don't wrap content in cards, panels, or outlined boxes; the framed cover screenshot is the only frame.
Don't round corners on any surface or bar.
Don't change a link's text color without the bar; the blue label must appear only where the bar has passed.
Don't set labels, nav, or data in Roboto, or paragraphs in mono.
